decision: Admit exactly one CPU-only execution of the original fixed H4 after disposition of the separate cloud primary sequence. No model, feature, split, target, candidate, metric or source-label change.
authorization: Root approved the bounded analysis under the user request to establish the plan-selection research motivation; code and tests are owned by the requested Terra model. This is an analysis-order admission, not a new GPU experiment.
data_state_at_admission: Old S1 and S2 are complete and their effects are known. Old cost is interrupted and old headline is not run. Cloud equivalence is complete and semantics is in progress; no cloud execution or cost outcome is used to choose whether to run H4. No real-data H4 fit has been performed; prior synthetic smoke tests are not study outcomes.

analysis.policy: Publish all six target/ablation results and all four fixed baselines regardless of direction. Preserve original tie rules and metrics. No hyperparameter search, new features, model selection, family holdout or new validity predictor.

common_requirements: sequence_ended is true and no primary stage status is running; bind the terminal disposition and available status files in H4 provenance.
Primary outcomes, significance and cost equivalence direction never determine activation. No new-cohort observations enter model fitting, evaluation, candidate filtering or baseline selection.
complete_requirements: All six cloud stage statuses are complete. Re-audited cloud report has no stage_errors. A protocol-clean cost equivalence negative is allowed.
technical_stop_requirements: Root explicitly records the fixed primary sequence as technically ended, with reason and hashes of available status files; missing files or mere waiting do not establish termination.
At least one primary stage status is stopped; all available primary statuses are not running.
Record which H1/H2/H3 evidence is missing; H4 cannot compensate for or establish that evidence.
activation.changed_gate_only: Do not require old cost/headline to become complete. Do not edit or reclassify any old stage, invoke old recovery, or describe new-cohort outcomes as completion of the old registered sequence.

execution_integrity.input: Re-audit old runtime identity, all selected row hashes, exact 36 accepted blocks, same block controls, frozen order, candidate eligibility and completed clean screen guard. Raw file contains71 calibration rows, which never enter labels or features.
execution_integrity.allowed_errors_elsewhere: Old interrupted cost and missing headline are reported but do not invalidate independently clean complete S1. Do not suppress any S1 or identity error.
execution_integrity.preserve_dependencies: Do not edit frozen learning_check.py or current running measurement dependencies. Implement a separate wrapper with new output directory.
execution_integrity.reservation: Create an exclusive run reservation and pre-fit provenance before calling run_learning; preserve every attempt. A pre-existing real-data fit reservation/result blocks automatic rerun.
execution_integrity.runtime: Record Python, sklearn, numpy and scipy versions plus wrapper SHA before fitting; retain frozen source bindings, terminal disposition, source rows, fold assignment and all results.
execution_integrity.checks: Completed result must contain exactly six outcomes with the fixed four nonempty folds each and original target/ablation identities; source_record_hashes and coverage must match this admission.

output.separation: Keep original study_id inside learning result and independent analysis_id in wrapper provenance. Never merge this artifact into the cloud cohort or overwrite old stage states.

interpretation: Auxiliary conditional selection among candidates already validated offline, including held-out candidates filtered using execution/numerical/semantic outcomes. Validity is excluded as a feature but is still used for eligibility; no precompile validity detection or online safe fallback is evaluated.

Primary comparison is fixed-model descriptor-containing versus workload+requested-knob features across held-out exact N. Positive results support limited conditional utility, not necessity of complex ML. Weak results do not disprove all structural methods.

Sixteen exact-N groups, thirty-six workloads and one old GPU environment are the evidence domain; candidate rows and graph samples are not independent generalization units. Sorted exact-N holdout is not odd-family or external-device validation.

Labels are the single S1 screening measurements, with screening noise and an optimistic tested-set oracle. Fixed default and training-only global baselines must be shown; full-S1 global and screen oracle are diagnostic and not leakage-free baselines.
Invalid held-out global choices remain unavailable, never imputed as zero performance or silently dropped without coverage. Report available and unavailable workloads beside every aggregate.

Observed few effective structures and many aliased requests make deduplication and simple rules strong alternatives; this fixed analysis does not compare all such policies or establish online necessity.
No training/inference/enumeration/validity/fallback cost or end-to-end single-compilation policy is established. No new H4 is performed in the cloud cohort.
